summary: Mitoxantrone carries a boxed warning in the United States, which is the FDA's strongest warning, for blood problems, heart harm, and misuse or addiction [3][4]. The FDA also warns that severe myelosuppression, meaning a severe drop in blood cell production, will occur when the drug is used in high doses [4]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium score of 51 for liver risk and a low score of 18 for heart risk [M]. One clinical trial studying this drug was even stopped early because of toxicity, meaning harmful side effects [6].
